theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M)
